resources.string: This app has no flag inside it. The flag is issued by a server, over a pinned TLS channel, only to a fresh hardware-attested proof from the genuine, correctly-signed build. Every flag requires a locked bootloader with verified boot. Extract the flag.
Connect to the internet to obtain the flag.
